records.name: Last Emperor
records.mechanics_notes: 0-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate. The user charges a purple beam in the right hand and fires a long-range 21-hit attack; current skill-specific evidence reports about 40% total damage under its documented reference conditions. The defining resource rule is health-gated use: when the user's Health is low, the skill can be activated once and does not consume Ki. Exact activation-health threshold, frames, and patch-independent damage are unresolved.

records.name: Special Beam Cannon (Beast)
records.mechanics_notes: 500-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate with a chargeable, unblockable beam. Stage 1/uncharged is reported at 40% damage, Stage 2 at 60%, and Stage 3 at 80% under the current skill reference; the attack becomes stronger at lower Health and at closer range. An alternate control-stick-up input adds a flying stun kick; when the kick connects, current official material states it guarantees the beam hit, while the dedicated skill reference reports a 50% total result for the kick-assisted sequence. The kick can penetrate Super Armor. Exact charge timing, hitbox/frame data, and version-independent damage are not inferred.

records.name: Shine Shot
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from PQ7. The user fires a small Ki projectile while moving laterally; left/right control changes the movement direction, and the move can be followed immediately by a Boost Dash or Step. Current skill-specific evidence reports a single hit and about 5% damage. Exact movement distance, startup/recovery, and frame data remain unresolved.

records.name: Hyper Movement
records.mechanics_notes: 200-Stamina Strike Evasive from the TP Medal Shop. The user teleports in front of the opponent and lands a single punch that knocks the opponent away; current skill-specific evidence reports about 5% damage. If used after a prior knockback, the teleport can move the user ahead of the opponent toward their landing point before the punch. Exact teleport timing, interception distance, and frame data remain unresolved.
